name: jev-browser
notes: The repository includes server code, a benchmark harness and results documentation. It requires Node.js, Chromium through Playwright and a TypeSafe API key with Jev access. The README reports comparative results against Playwright MCP.
summary: jev-browser is an MCP server that lets an agent navigate Chromium pages through Jev-selected actions. It checks page changes and returns uncertain steps to the driving agent.
